keep_playing_why: A gave me a score, combos (x36), three-star ratings, orders to chase and new towers and abilities every level, so I was always optimising something. B gave me one slow mirror puzzle and no score at all, and I would have quit it around 150 s.
better_made_why: A ran clean for 540 s with layered feedback (thwip, pop, cannon, wave ding, victory jingle, damage numbers, boss bar) and no visual glitches. B is the prettier world and has a cinematic gate reveal, but the camera cut to black about five times and the assist failed once at the island, so it felt less finished in motion.
